name: EPIC 248095314
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 16.5 solar radii and 1.48 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248095314 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.48776 (16th-84th percentiles 15.595357-17.468719), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,616 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.48 solar masses and 16.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,572 K at its surface.
